format: Studio / Custom events: callback-plus-Final minimum participation and withdrawal
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not any governing body's rule): a callback-plus-Final program needs at least two eligible couples to start and to apply advancement; a withdrawal that would leave fewer than two is refused with COMP_ADVANCEMENT_BELOW_MINIMUM; a withdrawn finalist is never replaced; apply never inserts a heat entry for a withdrawn pair. No single-couple scored callback Final in this release (the callback-plus-Final path only). Preserved by OD-21 Option A (owner decisions OD-15 A and OD-18 A, 2026-10-30).

implementation.symbol_or_migration: withdrawal below-minimum refusal; no heat entry inserted

enforcement_point: Callback advancement start guard and apply (A4/A4a/A0) and withdrawal function (A6) in the database; CF1 advancement SQL.

tests.name: OD-15 A: a withdrawal that would leave fewer than two is COMP_ADVANCEMENT_BELOW_MINIMUM and changes nothing

interpretation_notes: Approved and covered by SQL tests as written, but: (a) the scope is the callback-plus-Final path; whether other program types can run a scored Final with one couple was not audited here; (b) no policy label or disclosure exists on any surface; (c) SQL tests were not run for this docs-only entry. Never to be described as an NDCA, UCWDC or WSDC rule. OD-01 (PR 832) restrictions stand.
decision_refs: OD-21 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve Studio/Custom minimum-participation and withdrawal rules for initial activation; retrospective audit PR #795)
